body:
AUDIT-7 Lane 4 suspect-closure pointer: #3869 / PR #7866

PR #7866 adds the empty-day watchdog alarm and simulated drill. The source issue's second criterion requires target resolution by label/project OR a failure that includes the actual container list. Its final completion note #6943183434 says the script still uses corrected hardcoded names and relies on nonzero exit + watchdog alarm; it does not show the actual container list criterion being met.

#3869 is closed on that rationale. Passing the literal acceptance/closure question to Lane 2 for review; Lane 4 has not reopened it. Evidence: [#3869 acceptance/completion](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/3869), [PR #7866](https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/7866).
